steps.label: tooling-lint
command: scope=$(bun scripts/checks/pushScope.ts tooling); [ "$scope" = skip ] || bun run lint

steps.label: tooling-shell
command: scope=$(bun scripts/checks/pushScope.ts tooling); [ "$scope" = skip ] || bun run lint:shell

steps.label: tooling-typecheck
command: scope=$(bun scripts/checks/pushScope.ts tooling); [ "$scope" = skip ] || bun run typecheck

steps.label: api-shared-lint
command: scope=$(bun scripts/checks/pushScope.ts apiShared); [ "$scope" = skip ] || bun run --cwd packages/api-shared lint

steps.label: api-shared-typecheck
command: scope=$(bun scripts/checks/pushScope.ts apiShared); [ "$scope" = skip ] || bun run --cwd packages/api-shared typecheck

steps.label: backend-v2-lint
command: scope=$(bun scripts/checks/pushScope.ts backendV2); [ "$scope" = skip ] || bun run --cwd packages/backend-v2 lint

steps.label: backend-v2-typecheck
command: scope=$(bun scripts/checks/pushScope.ts backendV2); [ "$scope" = skip ] || bun run --cwd packages/backend-v2 typecheck

steps.label: terraform-format
command: scope=$(bun scripts/checks/pushScope.ts terraform); [ "$scope" = skip ] || terraform fmt -check -recursive terraform

steps.label: website-lint
command: scope=$(bun scripts/checks/pushScope.ts website); [ "$scope" = skip ] || bun run --cwd packages/website lint

steps.label: website-typecheck
command: scope=$(bun scripts/checks/pushScope.ts website); [ "$scope" = skip ] || bun run --cwd packages/website check
